test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Each of the following questions consists of 4 figures marked 1, 2, 3 and 4 called the Problem Figures followed by 4 other figures. Select a figure from amongst the Answer Figures which will continue the same series as established by the four Problem Figures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/181ef65a6f4779d1c203770acc6f59a5aec30dd8b8443ae6a4b5a088413bcae1.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Triangle is divided in 4 parts. And then shaded part inside the triangle is shifting in clockwise direction.

Rectangle is divided in 6 parts. And then shaded part inside the rectangle is shifting in an anticlockwise direction and rectangle is also rotating in anticlockwise direction by 90°.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d678bf7f3a24b86be7bcaad1638d11a87fbff8396ed28a4d6506b6cc8ebc77c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
